atlas.eightWayMapping: Movement and actor facing quantize to eight direction sectors. The source art contains six authored views; due-south chooses the nearest down diagonal and due-north chooses the nearest up diagonal, retaining the previous left/right side to avoid flicker. A true front/back drawing requires new source frames.

frameMethod.update: requestAnimationFrame drives idle and one-shot elapsed-time timing; walk/run phases use measured screen distance with the active mood cycle duration.
frameMethod.movingHold: Hold strong contact/rest/acting poses longer and reserve brief exposures for passing/accent poses.
frameMethod.locomotion: Walk and run phases advance by measured screen distance at the active mood’s researched cycle duration; Professor walking uses its profile’s travel lock and exposure duration. The actor holds its last gait phase while moving is still reported but travel stops; elapsed timing is used when screen-distance data is unavailable.
frameMethod.oneShots: One-shot actions spread the same key poses over their authored duration with short anticipation/accent exposures.
frameMethod.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion freezes atlas animation on its first stable pose.
frameMethod.quadrupedIdle: All five authored idle poses are now exposed in the idle sequence, with per-mood weighted holds and five-frame pixel differences retained from the supplied atlases.
frameMethod.microMovement: The full-body atlas frames carry the authored paw, face, and tail changes together. Five-frame idle exposure now shows those details at rest; gait phase follows travel to avoid advancing the feet while the actor is stationary.

base_cat.intent: neutral moving hold; quiet breath; full contact and recovery

caring.intent: soft attention with held readable poses and small response accents

hungry.intent: alert sniffing rhythm; brief anticipation accents before food actions

judgmental.intent: long dry holds with short, precise eye and head accents

listening.intent: listening hold; head and ear response follows the cue

purring.intent: slow rocking/purr cycle with a long settle

sleepy.intent: slow drooping holds; rare short blink or ear twitch

snuggly.intent: weighted sink and settle; tail follows the body pose

thinking.intent: hold the thought pose; let gaze/head accents land separately

thoughtful.intent: gentle head tilt, pause, and return with visible settling

advising_professor.intent: clear key poses, weighted holds, anticipatory rise, settle, and restrained seated moving holds

sourceInspection.atlasComparison: All 10 canonical mood atlases plus the meow/base atlas share a 30×22 layout. The mood atlases vary in rows 0–5; rows 6–21 are shared across the eight non-Professor moods and base. Professor remains the biped contact sheet and is not treated as a quadruped mood file.
sourceInspection.atlasDifference: The supplied mood atlas art contains mood-specific drawing variation for the initial idle/movement rows; other action rows remain shared source art. This pass applies independent timing profiles to every mood and routes the matching mood atlas into the virtual quadruped.

applicationCaveat: The atlas has six authored facings, not eight; straight north/south still use a stable nearest diagonal. Face, paws, and tail are bundled in the supplied full-body frames, so this pass animates their authored pixel changes as a unified sprite and does not invent split-part artwork.
